BiblicalUsage: The word means greatness, magnitude, and Paul uses it once, of the power of God toward believers: the exceeding greatness of His power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of His mighty power.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the greatness of God's power is not a doctrine to admire but a power toward us: the same working that raised Christ works in those who believe.
